Test fixtures: three real PALMOD V2.0.0 site files with the Bacon age
ensembles removed (see `data-raw/make_palmod_fixtures.R`).

- `GeoB3938_1` — an aDNA core that is present verbatim in PALMOD.
- `MD01_2412` — recalculated temperature as a `.lo` / central / `.hi` triple.
- `MD95_2024` — the neighbour of GeoB18549-1/-2; most Bacon ages are missing.

Data: Jonkers, L., Hollstein, M., Siccha, M., Kucera, M. (2026), PALMOD 130k
marine palaeoclimate data synthesis V2_0_0, PANGAEA,
https://doi.org/10.1594/PANGAEA.984602, licensed CC BY 4.0.
